businesses.business: modular space and portable storage leasing

offering_description.value: Leases and sells modular buildings, mobile offices, portable storage containers and tank and pump equipment to construction, education, government and industrial customers across North America. Equipment is delivered, installed and serviced through a network of branch locations.

primary_products.value: modular buildings; mobile offices; portable storage containers; tank and pump equipment; climate-controlled storage

primary_services.value: equipment delivery and installation; site setup; maintenance and relocation; ancillary equipment rental

customer_segment.value: B2B: construction contractors, industrial and energy companies, retailers, healthcare providers; B2G: school districts, universities, government agencies

end_markets.value: construction; education; government; healthcare; energy; retail

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: monthly or long-term rental of modular buildings and storage units; service fees: delivery, installation, setup and relocation charges; product sales: outright sales of modular units and containers to customers
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; service fees; product sales

value_chain_position.value: asset operator: owns and rents a large fleet of modular and storage units to customers; service provider: delivers, installs, maintains and removes units for business and public customers

geography_served.value: North America: United States, Canada and Mexico, through branch locations across the continent

specialization.value: related lines: modular space, portable storage, and tank and pump equipment sharing customers and branch network

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated branch network across North America; direct sales: sales teams serving national and local accounts; online: online ordering and quoting for rental customers

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: building codes, transport and safety rules affecting units and deliveries
